title: UAP authorization decision (uap-authorize/1)
description: The kernel's answer for one bundle. `allowed` plus a stable `code` is always present; a refusal carries the audit sequence and the intent's identifying fields, an allow carries the advisory record and a one-use permit. A client must treat anything that is not `allowed: true` as a refusal — there is no third state.

code.description: `allow`, `invalid-request`, or one of the kernel's 32 stable denial codes.

detail.description: Present only with `invalid-request`: what failed to parse. Never free text on a policy refusal.

permit.title: ActionPermit (embedded, no wire version of its own)
permit.description: A one-use permission to execute exactly one intent. Not a bearer token: an executor re-computes `intent_digest` from the arguments it is about to run and refuses a permit presented with different ones.
